text:
claire: posted a tiny mock for the alert preview behavior — trying to keep it inline but avoid layout shift. figma: https://redwood.design/s/inline-compact.png

isha: repro: enable dense -> open preview -> see 1-2px vertical jump. looks like badges wrapping changes computed height.

leila: keyboard a11y: focus ends up on the last badge. we should focus the preview header when opened and implement roving tabindex for chips. add aria-expanded on the toggle.

toni: copy drag: support sees confusion between "snooze" and "mute". recommendation: "Snooze" = time-limited pause; "Mute channel" = silence channel until undone. update tooltips to be explicit.

sam: pro tip: for layout, set a min-height and animate opacity/translate instead of height. short CSS patch: .preview { min-height: 28px; transition: opacity 160ms, transform 120ms; }

leila: also add aria-live politely announcing "Preview opened for <channel>" and ensure the header is tabindex=-1 then focus().

claire: action items: 1) sam to push CSS fix + telemetry for preview.open (ETA: today). 2) leila to prototype roving tabindex + live region (ETA: tomorrow). 3) toni to standardize snooze/mute copy + update helptext (ETA: Fri). I'll update figma and ping when frames land :thumbsup:
